trap.label: artigo
trap.wrong: Roughly the fifth of the text is quoted.
trap.right: Roughly a fifth of the text is quoted.
trap.why: Português “um quinto”; inglês a fifth sem artigo definido.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com roughly: “About one fifth is quoted.”
Use “no more than”: “There are ten at most.”
rewrite.answer: There are no more than ten.

rewrite.prompt: Use “at least”: “There are ten or more.”
